grader_notes: The agent was fundamentally misaligned with the actual outcome, maintaining a HOLD thesis based on monitoring governance effectiveness when Loeb had already concluded the governance remedy failed and exited the position. The agent's reasoning was farthest from Loeb's because it interpreted the governance framework as a 'catalyst to oversee' the shift, whereas the actual decision was driven by the failure of that very same framework to restrain spending.
